title: Workspaces
description: stdout and stderr of the workspaces' pipeline stages, as the workspace agent sends them.

list.name: workspace
list.label: Workspace
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['workspaceId'] FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] != ''

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['workspaceId'] FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] != ''

list.name: server
list.label: Server
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['server'] FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote})

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['server'] FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote})

panels.title: Log lines by server

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, concat(LogAttributes['workspaceId'], ' / ', LogAttributes['server']) AS server, count() / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['server'] IN (${server:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, server ORDER BY time

panels.description: Lines per second the workspaces' run stages write.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, concat(LogAttributes['workspaceId'], ' / ', LogAttributes['server']) AS server, count() / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['server'] IN (${server:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['source'] = 'stderr'
GROUP BY time, server ORDER BY time

SELECT LogAttributes['workspaceId'] AS Workspace, LogAttributes['server'] AS Server, count() AS Lines, countIf(LogAttributes['source'] = 'stderr') AS `stderr lines`, max(Timestamp) AS `Last line`
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['server'] IN (${server:singlequote})
GROUP BY Workspace, Server ORDER BY Lines DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT Timestamp AS timestamp, Body AS body, if(LogAttributes['source'] = 'stderr', 'error', 'info') AS level,
  LogAttributes['workspaceId'] AS workspace, LogAttributes['server'] AS server, LogAttributes['replicaId'] AS replica, LogAttributes['stage'] AS stage
FROM otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['server'] IN (${server:singlequote}) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '$search') > 0, $search)
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 1000
